# Body Atlas: Train & Nutrition

> A free Android app with a 3D model of the human body. Tap a muscle to see what it does and the best exercises for it (1,200+ exercises with start and end pictures); tap an organ or bone to see the nutrients it relies on and the foods richest in them (USDA FoodData Central data, ranked per serving). It also makes weekly training plans and has a journal for workouts, cardio, food and water. No subscription, no account, works offline, data stays on the phone, 7 languages (English, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese). Made by one developer, infrs.

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.infrs.bodyatlas
- Press kit: https://infrs.github.io/press.html
- Privacy policy: https://infrs.github.io/privacy.html
